🖨 Print drawing sheets

One page per player, with a box for every body part. Print at actual size (100%). Draw each part inside its box with a dark pen, colour it in if you like, then come back and press Upload a drawn sheet. (Designer: sheets follow the layout on screen now and carry their own code.)

📷 Upload a drawn sheet

Photograph your finished sheet from straight above, flat, in good light, with all four black corner squares in view. Each drawing is found for you: untick any you don't want, then press Use these drawings.
